name: OVOBench
intro: OVO-Bench 面向在线长视频理解，统一评测向后追溯、实时视觉感知和向前主动响应。论文版为 644 个视频、12 类任务和 2,814 条问答元标注；当前发布物另有不同计数与计分协议。
org: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Tsinghua University, Beihang University, Communication University of China, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, SenseTime Research, Shanghai Innovation Institute
build_method: 从公开数据集验证集/测试集与 YouTube 选视频，经已有精确时间戳、Gemini-1.5 粗标后人工精修、或志愿者直接标注三条路径生成元标注，再由 GPT-4o 辅助和人工补充问答、构造视觉相关干扰项并逐题复核。
metric: 论文：准确率及 REC/SSR/CRR 时序加权指标；已发布计分器：仅准确率式规则计分和任务/模式均值
task_type: 在线视频理解, 多项选择问答, 时机感知响应
eval_feature: 后向追溯, 实时视觉感知, 前向主动响应
scale: 论文版 644 个视频、2,814 条问答元标注；当前 JSON 为 1,640 条顶层记录、展开后 3,035 个时间戳测试，README 写 3,100 个查询
task_type_en: Online Video Understanding, Multiple-choice QA, Timing-aware Response
build_method_en: Select public-dataset validation/test videos plus YouTube; create metadata by reusing precise timestamps, human-refining Gemini-1.5 coarse timestamps, or direct volunteer annotation; then combine GPT-4o-assisted and human QA writing, grounded distractors, and per-QA manual review.
eval_feature_en: Backward tracing, real-time visual perception, and forward active responding
intro_en: OVO-Bench evaluates online long-video understanding through backward tracing, real-time visual perception, and forward active responding. The paper release has 644 videos, 12 tasks, and 2,814 QA meta-annotations; the current artifacts use different counts and scoring.
scale_en: Paper: 644 videos and 2,814 QA meta-annotations; current JSON: 1,640 top-level records and 3,035 expanded timestamp tests; README: 3,100 queries
metric_en: Paper: accuracy plus timing-weighted REC/SSR/CRR metrics; released scorer: accuracy-only rules with task, mode, and overall means

drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-18. Evidence lock: the reviewed paper is arXiv:2501.05510v2; PDF SHA-256 dc5fc42ff20c077088a286b56727fb55e4760a25c6fc7f0189338fa56dafdfe8 and arXiv source-tar SHA-256 9367e809f192301b89e4722ce159bcabe94c477dac2563121e411c29d0987454. The official JoeLeelyf/OVO-Bench Git revision is c34093f9a072d93f9e1c6b923446dfba71f4528e. Its current JSON SHA-256 is dc4a90daf26764dc8ab8b228ea4af864ba2ea50c2833ead8c9af6573f78ccf97 and released scorer SHA-256 is 2a03be7992ba0871f9eb7db8cf7f326591635ffb7ed0e435e468f30dfefb18dc. The fixed media repository revision is fec29e3385747b5642d995370143ba92d2819bd2 and its README SHA-256 is 13292e5c81efc39780f368a755d578809bcf0f6568c3d2f410e659645308304d. Construction trace: OVO-Bench defines Backward Tracing, Real-Time Visual Perception, and Forward Active Responding. The task list resolves to 3 backward tasks (EPM, ASI, HLD), 6 real-time tasks (STU, OJR, ATR, ACR, OCR, FPD), and 3 forward tasks (REC, SSR, CRR), for 12 tasks total. Figure 2's caption says 14 tasks, but the abstract, body, and enumerated task list support 12; the caption discrepancy remains visible. Sources include QA-Ego4D and OpenEQA for EPM; STAR, YouCook2, CrossTask, HiREST, and COIN for ASI; Perception-Test and THUMOS for REC; COIN for SSR; MovieNet for CRR; Ego4D for real-time tasks; and supplementary YouTube videos. Existing datasets contribute validation/test splits only. Three meta-annotation paths are preserved: repurpose accurate event timestamps; let Gemini-1.5 generate coarse timestamps and have humans refine them; or have volunteers author SSR/CRR questions, answers, and ground-truth timestamps. Annotators inspect source videos and metadata. Candidate QAs use random short clips, GPT-4o selection or generation with human-refined prompts, additional human-proposed questions, and volunteer-authored CRR cases. Backward and real-time MCQs use 2–5 options with rule-based and visually grounded wrong answers. Humans review every QA and shuffle options. Paper protocol: the paper release reports 644 unique videos, 2,814 QA meta-annotations, seven domains, and 12 tasks. Backward and real-time inputs run from clip start through query time. Forward tasks densely query the timeline. REC uses exact response correctness with timing parameters p1 = 0.2 and p2 = 0.05; SSR/CRR use GPT-4o effectiveness judging with timing decay p = 0.5. The main paper table is accuracy-based, but the timing-aware definitions remain part of the stated protocol. Current-edition reconciliation: the fixed JSON has 1,640 top-level records over 644 unique videos and expands to 3,035 timestamp tests; the README says 3,100 queries. These counts are reported separately rather than replacing the paper's 2,814. The released scorer checks response-letter membership for backward/real-time tasks, concatenates digits for REC exact comparison, and uses N/Y or Yes/No membership for SSR/CRR. It has no GPT-4o judge and no timing-weighted score. It computes per-task means, unweighted mode means, and an overall unweighted mean of the three modes. License boundary: the paper and repository state that annotations use CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the HF card metadata states CC BY-SA 4.0; the separate Git code LICENSE is MIT, while all source-dataset terms still apply. This conflict is not collapsed into a single unrestricted label, so openness is public, noncommercial license. The repository includes a static leaderboard image but no submission workflow or verifiable public leaderboard service, so has_leaderboard=false. The bilingual specs use identical 24-node/27-edge topology, academic-paper profile, academic-color theme, horizontal layout, orthogonal routing, and explicit dashed styling on every evidence, artifact, license, or drift edge. Formal publication evidence [site-a11z-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3129×1465 (English) and 3115×1465 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3127×1463 and 3113×1463. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
